router_body:
name: plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: full job set selected
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix') }}
        run: echo 'SELECTED difftest tier'
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix') }}
      - name: local gate wiring proof
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix') }}
        run: python3 -I ci/local-gate-test.py
      - name: local evidence gate
        if: ${{ !(github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix')) }}
        run: echo 'Local gauntlet evidence is the gate; request ci or full-matrix for CI.'

ci.yml.difftest:
strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        tier: [native, release]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: host
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          command -v clang || { sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq clang; }
          clang --version
          getconf GNU_LIBC_VERSION
          uname -srm

      - name: the pinned wolf, by digest
        shell: bash
        run: tools/fetch-toolchain

      # muzzle#4: tools/build runs the pin's compiler or refuses. The
      # test stages a stale one where the build would find it.
      - name: the stale compiler (${{ matrix.tier }})
        shell: bash
        run: tests/stale-compiler ${{ matrix.tier }}

      - name: build (${{ matrix.tier }})
        shell: bash
        run: tools/build ${{ matrix.tier }}

      - name: difftest (${{ matrix.tier }})
        shell: bash
        run: tools/difftest ${{ matrix.tier }}

      - name: keep the outputs
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: difftest-${{ matrix.tier }}
          path: out/${{ matrix.tier }}
          if-no-files-found: ignore

  # The run's verdict, and its name: `tier full`, muzzle's one tier. It needs
  # every job, runs unless the run was cancelled, proves the wiring first
  # (ci/tiers-test.py) and fails unless every job succeeded (ci/tiers.py
  # verdict). lane-audit.sh reads this job's name and conclusion.
ci.yml.tier:
name: tier full
    if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
    needs: [difftest]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: the wiring can say no (ci/tiers-test.py)
        run: python3 ci/tiers-test.py
      - name: every job succeeded
        env:
          NEEDS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
        run: python3 ci/tiers.py verdict

  # A red nightly opens an issue (ruling #92): a scheduled run has no lane
  # watching it, so the red has to come and find one. One open issue per
  # workflow, its title the dedupe key; a further red night comments on it
  # (ci/nightly-red.sh, tested by ci/tiers-test.py T8). Never on a pull
  # request, a push or a dispatch: those reds have a lane attached already.
ci.yml.nightly-red:
name: nightly red, an issue
    needs: tier
    if: ${{ failure() && github.event_name == 'schedule' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: open or update the nightly-red issue
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          WORKFLOW: ${{ github.workflow }}
          RUN_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
        run: ci/nightly-red.sh
